tool.name: 3Dtrees: Raster
tool.description: forest-structure metrics, DTM, CHM and voxel counts
tool.command: cp '$point_cloud' 'input.$point_cloud.ext' && #if $area.restrict == 'yes': cp '$area.aoi' aoi.geojson && #end if mkdir -p output && Rscript /opt/raster/raster.R --point-cloud 'input.$point_cloud.ext' #if $area.restrict == 'yes': --aoi-geojson aoi.geojson #end if #if str($instance_dimension): --instance-dimension '$instance_dimension' #end if $denoise --denoise-neighbors '$advanced.denoise_neighbors' --denoise-sigma '$advanced.denoise_sigma' --tile-size '$advanced.tile_size' --grid-search-step '$advanced.grid_search_step' --voxel-resolution '$advanced.voxel_resolution' --voxel-count-resolution '$advanced.voxel_count_resolution' --dtm-resolution '$advanced.dtm_resolution' --chm-resolution '$advanced.chm_resolution' --ptd-resolution '$advanced.ptd_resolution' --vegetation-minimum-height '$advanced.vegetation_minimum_height' --gap-height-threshold '$advanced.gap_height_threshold' --minimum-tree-voxels '$advanced.minimum_tree_voxels' --apex-minimum-height '$advanced.apex_minimum_height' --minimum-tree-thickness '$advanced.minimum_tree_thickness' --minimum-occupied-layers '$advanced.minimum_occupied_layers' --raster-format '$advanced.raster_format' --output-dir output --temp-dir "\${TMPDIR:-\$_GALAXY_JOB_TMP_DIR}" && touch output/raster_voxel_counts.copc.laz

param.name: point_cloud
param.label: Segmented point cloud
param.help: One full-resolution point cloud with at least one tree instance dimension (PredInstance, PredInstance_SAT, PredInstance_FM or PredInstance_RCT); coordinates in metres, a CRS (if present) projected in metres.

param.name: restrict
param.label: Restrict to an area of interest
param.help: Without an area of interest the full point-cloud extent is analysed.

param.name: aoi
param.label: Area of interest
param.help: Polygon or MultiPolygon (GeoJSON) in the point cloud's coordinate system; it is not reprojected. Only whole tiles and voxel cells inside it are reported.

param.label: Instance dimensions
param.help: Leave empty to process every one present of PredInstance, PredInstance_SAT, PredInstance_FM and PredInstance_RCT. Or type one or more of them, separated by commas without spaces; each must exist in the point cloud, otherwise the job fails.

validator.message: Enter PredInstance, PredInstance_SAT, PredInstance_FM or PredInstance_RCT, separated by commas without spaces

param.label: Remove noise points
param.help: kNN distance filter: flags points whose mean distance to their nearest neighbours exceeds the whole cloud's mean plus two standard deviations (settings under Advanced parameters). The terrain model, canopy models and tile metrics then use the remaining points; raw voxel counts always include every recorded point.

section.name: advanced
section.title: Advanced parameters
section.help: Defaults are the published 3Dtrees settings. Every run records the values it used in its run provenance.

param.label: Tile size (m)
param.help: Width of the square analysis tiles.

param.label: Tile-grid search step (m)
param.help: Step of the offset search that places the tile grid. Must not exceed the tile size.

param.label: Metric voxel size (m)
param.help: Voxel edge length for the tile and tree metrics. Must divide 1 m evenly, for example 0.1, 0.2, 0.25, 0.5 or 1.

validator.message: Must divide 1 m evenly, for example 0.1, 0.2, 0.25, 0.5 or 1

param.validator: abs(1 / value - round(1 / value)) <= 1e-9 * max(1, 1 / value)

param.label: Voxel count size (m)
param.help: Voxel edge length, horizontal and vertical, of the voxel point counts.

param.label: DTM resolution (m)
param.help: Must divide 60 m evenly, for example 0.5, 1, 2 or 5.

validator.message: Must divide 60 m evenly, for example 0.5, 1, 2 or 5

param.validator: abs(60 / value - round(60 / value)) <= 1e-9 * max(1, 60 / value)

param.label: CHM resolution (m)
param.help: Must divide 1 m evenly, for example 0.1, 0.2, 0.25, 0.5 or 1.

validator.message: Must divide 1 m evenly, for example 0.1, 0.2, 0.25, 0.5 or 1

param.validator: abs(1 / value - round(1 / value)) <= 1e-9 * max(1, 1 / value)

param.label: Ground-seed resolution (m)
param.help: Seed resolution of the progressive TIN densification (PTD) ground classification.

param.label: Gap height threshold (m)
param.help: CHM height below which a cell counts as a canopy gap.

param.label: Minimum tree voxels
param.help: Occupied metric voxels a segment needs to be accepted as a tree.

param.label: Minimum apex height (m)
param.help: A tree's highest point must be strictly above this height.

param.label: Minimum tree thickness (m)
param.help: Smallest PCA extent a tree must reach.

param.label: Raster format
param.help: Format of the DTM, CHM, DSM and voxel-count rasters. A Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF is a regular GeoTIFF that web viewers can read in parts.

param.label: Minimum occupied layers
param.help: One-metre height layers a tree must occupy.

param.label: Noise filter: neighbours
param.help: Nearest neighbours for each point's mean distance, counting the point itself as lidR::sor() does. Used only with Remove noise points.

param.label: Noise filter: standard deviations
param.help: Points whose mean distance exceeds the whole cloud's mean plus this many standard deviations are flagged. Used only with Remove noise points.

tool.help:
# What it does
3Dtrees: Raster computes fixed-size tile metrics of forest structure (20 m tiles by default) from one segmented point cloud. It also writes a digital terrain model (DTM), a canopy height model (CHM), a digital surface model (DSM), full-resolution voxel point counts (0.5 m voxels by default) and provenance records. No points are subsampled, and the input file is never modified. The method and every output are described in the [tool README](https://github.com/3dTrees-earth/3Dtrees_Raster#readme).
# Input
- **Segmented point cloud**: one full-resolution LAS/LAZ or COPC file with a CRS projected in metres, or no CRS (then the products carry none), and at least one supported tree instance dimension: `PredInstance`, `PredInstance_SAT` (SegmentAnyTree), `PredInstance_FM` (ForestMamba) or `PredInstance_RCT` (RayCloudTools). - **Restrict to an area of interest** (default No): select Yes to supply a GeoJSON polygon in the point cloud's XY coordinates. Only whole tiles and voxel columns inside it are reported. - **Instance dimensions** (optional): empty processes every one of the dimensions above that the point cloud has. Or name one or more, separated by commas without spaces; the job fails if one is missing from the point cloud. - **Remove noise points** (default off): the kNN distance filter flags points whose mean distance to their 8 nearest neighbours exceeds the whole cloud's mean plus two standard deviations. The terrain model, canopy models and tile metrics then use the remaining points. - **Advanced parameters**: tile size, voxel sizes, raster resolutions and the tree-acceptance thresholds. Metric voxels and CHM cells must divide 1 m evenly, and DTM cells must divide 60 m. Keep the defaults to stay comparable with other 3Dtrees products.
CPU, memory and scratch space come from the Galaxy job allocation.
# Outputs
Per instance dimension (collections named by dimension):
- **Tile metrics**: one row per tile with vegetation density, height statistics, vertical complexity, canopy roughness and tree statistics. - **Segment diagnostics**: one row per segment with the tree-acceptance checks, apex position, crown area and voxel volume. - **Tiles**: the tile metrics as GeoJSON polygons.
Shared:
- **DTM**, **CHM** and **DSM** as Cloud Optimized GeoTIFFs (plain GeoTIFF on request), and a PNG tile overview. - **Voxel point counts**: occupied voxels as CSV, a multiband UInt32 GeoTIFF (band b holds heights from (b-1)×s to b×s above the DTM for voxel size s), a validity raster (0 excluded, 1 valid, 2 invalid DTM), the same voxels as a COPC point cloud for 3D viewers (an empty dataset when no voxel is occupied), and grid metadata. Counts include every recorded point, also those flagged as noise. - **Rejected noise points** and a **Denoising report** (with the filter only). - **Run provenance** and **Analysis footprint** records.
